start: Member already in the gym; opened Settings, Your gym

steps.action: Tap "Gym logo on my home screen" ("Opens MettleUp from your home screen")
user_sees: Android's "Add to home screen?" question
must_not: Nothing happens

user_sees: "<gym> is already on your home screen. Its picture is up to date."
must_not: A second shortcut

start: Member's phone offline, or the gym logo cannot be downloaded

steps.action: Tap "Gym logo on my home screen"
user_sees: "Couldn't get <gym>'s logo. Check the internet and try again."
must_not: A shortcut with a blank picture
The app freezing while it waits

s1 not: a broken file is not taken as a logo

start: Phone whose home screen cannot take shortcuts (or Android older than 8)

steps.action: Open Settings, Your gym
user_sees: No "Gym logo on my home screen" row
must_not: A row that does nothing when tapped

steps.action: (Gym without a logo) open Settings, Your gym
user_sees: No shortcut row
must_not: A shortcut drawn without the gym's logo

start: Shortcut on the home screen; member leaves the gym, then joins again

steps.action: Leave the gym, then tap the shortcut
user_sees: The shortcut greyed out with "You left <gym>. Open MettleUp from its own icon."
must_not: The shortcut still opens the app as the old gym

steps.action: Join the same gym again
user_sees: The shortcut works again
must_not: A second shortcut

steps.action: Gym owner uploads a new logo; member opens the app
user_sees: The shortcut redrawn with the new logo, nothing asked
must_not: The old logo kept
Android's add question shown again

tests.checks: s1: 'You left G. Open MettleUp from its own icon.'; s3: redrawn only when the logo or name changed. Working again after joining is not checked
s1: 'You left G. Open MettleUp from its own icon.'; s3: redrawn only when the logo or name changed. Working again after joining is not checked
